Restarts sharing if Android closes the app, and after the phone restarts. Requires location “Allow all the time” and an exemption from battery optimization.
To restart sharing without you opening the app, Android requires location access “Allow all the time”. On the next screen, choose “Allow all the time”.
Without “Allow all the time”, sharing cannot be restarted in the background.
Without the battery optimization exemption, Android prevents restarting sharing.

Precise location (GPS). Your position is sent at this pace, only if you actually moved. When you set off again after a stop, the others are told right away.
When the motion sensor shows that the device does not move, the GPS is turned off and your position is only confirmed at this pace. Never more often than while moving.
One address per line (wss://…). Positions are end-to-end encrypted: relays only see random-looking data. Using several relays keeps the app working if some disappear.
whereAreYou %1$s — free software (GPL-3.0-or-later). No account, no server of our own. Map: OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles, data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
whereAreYou is built on these free projects, services and specifications. Tap one to open its website.
Collaborative world map: all the map data (roads, buildings, places).
Free map tile hosting and styles (light and dark), with no key and no account.
Vector tile schema and map styles used by OpenFreeMap.
Open source library that draws the vector map and the markers.
Open protocol whose public relays carry the encrypted positions: no server of our own.
Schnorr signature specification on the secp256k1 curve, required by Nostr and used to sign every message.
Network library: WebSocket connections to the relays.
Library that generates and reads the invitation QR codes.
Camera screen to scan QR codes, based on ZXing.
Android libraries and user interface toolkit.
Programming language of the app and its background tasks.
Tips for each phone brand to keep apps running in the background.
